g.text: TIMELINE: 12 WEEKS · PLATFORM: WEB & TABLET · WCAG 2.2 AA
Restructured from 120+ unsegmented legacy fields into a guided, 4-phase decision model.

text.tspan: "Teams didn't need another dense data sheet.
They needed shared clarity on what changed,
what it means, and what happens next."
Lead responsibilities across compliance systems & design tokens.
